note: Hand-curated part of the LANA AI client open-source inventory: the Electron runtime, the vendored browser libraries in public_html/js/vendor, icons, CSS and fonts. npm packages bundled into electron-dist and the Tiptap bundle are found by esbuild at generation time. Licenses were checked against each project's LICENSE file at the vendored version on 2026-11-04. Run node scripts/licenses/generate.js after any change.
